scoringCalibration: Visual realism is scored independently; passing topology, collision and runtime checks cannot compensate for weak face, skin, hair, clothing or deformation quality.
technicalBasis: Blender hair curves may be attached to a UV surface for offline grooming.
Curves are converted to mesh geometry before Aevrynd glTF export.
visualFindings: The continuous projected scalp removes the large exposed gray scalp regions at the crown and front part.
The front hairline is continuous and smoother than the disconnected v20 foundation.
Narrow translucent boundary clumps soften the side and rear edge but remain too subtle to fully hide the cap boundary.
The primary strands still read as many straight independent fibers rather than hierarchical game hair clumps.
The side and nape silhouette still resembles a short undercut and lacks intentional styling.
blockingFailures: The groom needs hand-shaped large and medium clump cards with a coherent part and controlled overlap.
Ear, temple and nape transitions still need asymmetric silhouette breakup and denser coverage.
Hair materials need dedicated strand-direction anisotropy and alpha textures validated in the Aevrynd renderer.
The eyelid folds, medial canthi, lacrimal caruncles and orbital fat pads still need integrated sculpted topology.
The mouth base needs a true mouth slit, oral cavity and animation-ready corner loops.
Skin requires region-specific albedo, pore direction, roughness, oiliness, redness and subsurface response.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the two audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
